abstract: Spermatocytic seminoma of the testis is a specific clinicopathologic entity and a unique germ cell neoplasm without a homologous counterpart in the ovary or in extragonadal sites. Six spermatocytic seminomas were subjected to a detailed ultrastructural study, and seven spermatocytic seminomas were analyzed using microspectrophotometry. Five classic seminomas were also subjected to microspectrophotometric analysis for comparison. Ultrastructurally, spermatocytic seminoma cells were shown to contain a larger number of cytoplasmic organelles than classic seminoma, but they did not exhibit structures that are diagnostic of cells capable of meiotic division and precursors of acrosomes. Microspectrophotometric analysis confirmed the absence of haploid cells and indicated that spermatocytic seminoma cells have lower modal numbers than classic seminoma cells. The majority of spermatocytic seminomas exhibit hyperdiploid or peritriploid DNA modal values, whereas in classic seminomas these values range from peritriploid to peripentaploid. These findings support the view that spermatocytic seminoma represents a better differentiated variant of seminoma than the classic type, but they oppose the view that spermatocytic seminoma is composed of spermatocytes capable of meiotic division. It is considered that spermatocytic seminoma is composed of cells differentiating in the direction of spermatocytes but which have not yet reached this stage of differentiation.
abstract_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマは、精巣に特異的な臨床病理学的疾患単位であり、卵巣や性腺外には相同する組織がない、独特の胚細胞腫瘍です。精母細胞性セミノーマ6例を超微細構造的に詳細に検討し、7例を顕微分光測光法で解析しました。比較のため古典的セミノーマ5例も顕微分光測光解析を行いました。超微細構造では、精母細胞性セミノーマ細胞は古典的セミノーマよりも多くの細胞質小器官を有していましたが、減数分裂能や先体の前駆体を示す構造は認められませんでした。顕微分光測光解析では半数体細胞の不在が確認され、精母細胞性セミノーマ細胞は古典的セミノーマ細胞よりも低いモード数を示しました。精母細胞性セミノーマの多くは過二倍体または準三倍体のDNAモード値を示し、古典的セミノーマでは準三倍体から準五倍体の範囲でした。これらの知見は、精母細胞性セミノーマが古典型よりも分化の進んだセミノーマの亜型であるという見方を支持する一方、精母細胞が減数分裂能を持つという見方には反対するものです。精母細胞性セミノーマは、精母細胞の方向へ分化しつつも、まだその段階に到達していない細胞から構成されていると考えられます。
